title: fix(app-shell): Installed Apps module toggle names its module rows in aria-controls
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBA6p6wR5XRGmnECFZqr87FM)_

Refs #34722 (follow-up to #34815; L1 6947097720 should-fix 1; seat-3 follow-up record 6953744953)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：设置 › 已安装应用里"展开/收起模块"按钮的 `aria-controls` 现在指向真实存在的模块行：每个模块行有自己的 id，展开时按钮列出这些 id，收起时不带 `aria-controls`（此时模块行不渲染）。`aria-expanded` 不变。
- **为什么改**：#34815 的 L1 指出该按钮的 `aria-controls` 指向一个不存在的元素，读屏软件无从定位，axe 的 `aria-valid-attr-value` 规则会报错。
- **风险与回滚**：只加了 DOM id 与一个无障碍属性，界面外观和交互不变；回滚＝回退本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` 的 `moduleRowDomId` 与按钮上的 `aria-controls`；测试文件新增的 aria-controls 用例。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx`，预期 17/17 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地

## What changes

L1 6947097720 on #34815 found that the module toggle in Setup › Installed Apps carried `aria-controls` set to `pkg-modules-` plus the app's row id, and that no element had that id: the module lines were bare table rows. The seat ruled for ids over dropping the attribute.

- Each folded module row now gets its own DOM id: the page's `React.useId()` prefix, then `pkg-module-`, then the module's row id passed through `encodeURIComponent`. The prefix keeps the id unique if the page is ever mounted twice; the encoding keeps it free of whitespace, so it is one token of an IDREF list (row ids with dots, such as `app.objectstack.hotcrm.o2c`, pass through unchanged). A module folds under exactly one app (`appOfModule`), so no id repeats across groups.
- The toggle's `aria-controls` is the space-separated list of its module rows' ids while they are shown (by click, or opened by a search hit), and is omitted while collapsed, when those rows are not rendered.
- `aria-expanded` is unchanged.

| | Before (origin/main e05445e4f5) | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Collapsed | `aria-expanded="false"`, `aria-controls` names a missing id | `aria-expanded="false"`, no `aria-controls` |
| Expanded | `aria-expanded="true"`, `aria-controls` names a missing id (axe `aria-valid-attr-value` violation) | `aria-expanded="true"`, `aria-controls` lists the ids of the drawn module rows; axe finds no violation |

Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`. The package is private, but its code ships inside the built Console that `@objectstack/console` publishes, and `.changeset/config.json` versions private packages (`privatePackages.version: true`); #34815 shipped its app-shell change the same way. So a changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` is not applied.

## Tests

One new case in the existing harness file `PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx`, inside the folding `describe`:

- collapsed: the toggle has no `aria-controls`;
- expanded: every id in `aria-controls` resolves through `document.getElementById` to a drawn module row of HotCRM, one per module (all four), each with `data-module-of` set to the app;
- axe-core (the helper `ConsoleLayout.oneMainLandmark-13334.test.tsx` already uses in app-shell), rule `aria-valid-attr-value` only, on the expanded table: zero violations, with a control that the rule judged a node carrying `aria-controls`;
- collapsed again: no `aria-controls`.

Ablation (one-shot, not kept): deleting the row `id` attribute via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 049bd99f62bb to d334c876df6c) turned the new case red (`expected [ undefined, undefined, …(2) ] to deeply equal [ …(4) ]`; 1 failed, 16 passed). Restored: blob equals HEAD (049bd99f62bb), `git diff HEAD` empty.
